# whyasaf

## Projects
- [Lecmic](https://lecmic.whyasaf.com): lecture assistant for university students. Live transcription and translation of lectures, notes, recordings and PDFs in one place, summaries, vocabulary notebook, audio transcription. Source: https://github.com/whyasaf/lecmic
- [CodeVocab AI](https://codevocab.whyasaf.com): Python & NLP platform that verifies English sentences instantly. Source: https://github.com/whyasaf/CodeVocab
- [Neon Oto Kurtarma](https://neonotokurtarma.com): website and logo design
- [Cultivated Voice System](https://www.cultivatedvoicesystem.com/): English education system
- [Plus Otoyol](https://plusotoyol.com): transportation technologies
- Kaçış Alanı F1: Formula 1 Instagram page (https://www.instagram.com/kacisalanif1/)
- zerP Finance: minimalist personal finance tracker (closed concept)
